notes.title: Version 0.3.4: New tag labels
notes.notes:
Changed tag labelling: Tags are being listed as "avoid, own and catch" in the top left and in the rest of the game now, instead of the previous "rock, paper and scissors"
Added some air control (i.e. when you are in the air from jumping or falling, you have bit of control where you'll land)
Decreased footstep sound distance, walls muffle them

notes.title: Version 0.3.3
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made to the game:

When using the target and distance ability, the distance is shown as a number now
NPCs are turning more smoothly now
Minor improvements to the first learn to play level

notes.title: Version 0.3.2
notes.notes:
Thanks to the feedback of the past days (including Steam Next Fest), the following features have been added to the game.

New setting whether to notify when NPCs catch NPCs
Host can kick players from round setup screen
Fixed texture alignment

notes.title: Version 0.3.1: Emoji system
notes.notes:
To avoid language barriers and to prevent toxicity, A Catchy Game: IntraTag's communication system now features several emojis instead of a chat system. (If you'd like to chat with other players please feel free to use Steam chat or join the game's discord at https://discord.gg/jMcjmUMMPb.)
Faster start in the first learn to play level
